title: The waiting page gets its final look, in every repo at once
why: Your worry, Oct 26: "is it already too late to decide the look ... I realize i allowed a beta to be the final product". It is not too late: every repo's page comes from one template, skills/waiting-page/page.html.
note: Final design (Oct 26, 20:15 CDT; version 9 at 22:58 CDT): https://claude.ai/artifact/2DodmME3zxVTmi26B3KzBR, source plans/waiting-mockups/final-combined.html. From shiv's answers (Oct 26, 20:01-20:42 CDT): one stable list, no one-at-a-time view; nothing preselected (my pick is marked, Take my pick fills it in one tap); one Send with a stamp and Undo, replacing per-card Save and Accept every pick (closes c74); tiers Blocking, Upcoming, Whenever, each word once as its section heading (c106); phone and Mac equally; no key hints; CDT times; Atkinson type; a receipts trail. Colour: the repo colour is one slim 44px sticky header bar with flat counts, a tinted ground and contrast-checked ink, never the whole page; a repo with no colour gets one from the shared wheel (c105); state colours turn away from a repo hue within 30 degrees and reach 4.5:1 on every surface; the Blocking line is a solid red fill. Related items sit in one frame with one sentence on how they connect. The left rail is an overview (progress and counts), not a second list. A Designs tab holds each open question's mockup (c112). Next: shiv's look, then a build lane on skills/waiting-page, which also republishes each live page with the db and comments capabilities to turn c99 on. Port: yes, through the skill.
